video.title: AI欧腐《霓虹囚宠：被星际海盗缠上了/Neon Captive: Coiled Around by a Star Pirate》
video.desc:
In an interstellar age, billionaire Caius arrives at Neon-7 and is consumed by desire for untouchable heir Emrys Vane. They shouldn’t want each other, but secrets coil beneath the neon—and the closer they get, the more they realize both are hiding something.
星际时代，亿万富豪Caius来到霓虹七号，对高不可攀的继承人Emrys Vane产生了无法自拔的渴望。他们本不该渴望彼此，可霓虹之下暗藏着层层秘密。靠得越近，他们越发现，彼此都有所隐瞒。
